_comment: The eighteen Roots. 'canon' Roots are the Twelve the Meridian Court teaches; the other six were struck from the Canon (docs/03_axiom_system.md). 'ops' is the whitelist of grammar operations a Root's laws may use. 'status' is honest: only Roots marked SLICE have laws in data/laws/.

PERCEPTION.question: What is known of a thing?

REFLECTION.governs: correspondence: what one thing shares with another, now

IDENTITY.governs: tags: what a thing counts as

ABSENCE.governs: eligibility: whether a thing can be acted on at all

DEBT.governs: the ledger: consequences owed and when they are paid

THRESHOLD.governs: boundaries: what may pass from one side to another

OWNERSHIP.governs: control: whose a thing, an act or a law is

RUIN.governs: integrity: how much a guard, a construct or a law can bear

CONTINUITY.governs: persistence: states that refuse to end

ADAPTATION.governs: exposure: what a thing has met before changes how it meets it

SILENCE.governs: notice: whether an act is witnessed by other laws

REVELATION.governs: knowledge: what is read, marked and cannot be denied

MEMORY.governs: the record: what happened, replayed against the present

VELOCITY.governs: momentum: speed as something kept and spent

DISTANCE.governs: the metric: how far apart two things are treated as being

HUNGER.governs: appetite: what is consumed and what it becomes

PERMISSION.governs: licence: which acts are allowed to be completed

POSSIBILITY.governs: the alternative: what else could have happened
